1.

All I would leave to Jesus, All to Him I gladly bear. Him I would trust and love, In His company walk here.

C.

I now leave all. Yes, I leave all. All to Thee, my precious Jesus. I now leave all.

2.

Jesus, all I surrender, Give myself entirely to Thee. Fill me with Thy power and love, Send a shower of grace on me.

3.

All to Jesus I surrender, Holy fervour now fills me. For the full salvation’s joy, Praise be to God eternally!
